summary: ADR-0059 accepted 2026-08-18; valid published/LKG catalog may replay frozen selection against current selected bytes into validator-owned successor context; selection hash excludes source bytes; context hash binds selection, current source hashes, snapshot, Locator result, decisions, predecessor; authority envelope binds governing artifacts and allowed successor kinds; stale freshness/query-quality may degrade unrelated execution only when selection, authority, modules, and read-set verify; publication failure cannot advance current/LKG or invalidate valid LKG; integrity, authority, contract, policy, protected-path, command/test, selection, or Knowledge self-change failures block or require semantic review; rapid-evolution profile allows same-selection degraded successor execution only, not publication/lifecycle/authority replacement; production/release requires current published Knowledge, publication-quality checks, and semantic-review evidence; extends ADR-0048/0050; supersedes only ADR-0057 stale-stop interpretation; publication query gate and LKG integrity remain strict.
